text_block_list.name: Campus Broadcast
text_block_list.text:
"—Trainer <username>, please report to the 
Chairwoman's Office immediately."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Summoned by an alarming broadcast, I 
hurried over to the Chairwoman's office."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Indeed, come in.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ...Please, have a seat.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An eerie silence...! The stillness 
continued for several minutes afterwards—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm starting to get uneasy. Could it 
be that something terrible has happened?"
choice_data_list: Um! What in the world is going on...?!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Appreciation!!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Today, I asked you out here so I could 
express my gratitude to you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! The trainee you're in charge 
of, <chrname>, isâ

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
She ran through the crucial third year of 
the Twinkle Series with a magnificent 
brilliance!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"The path she carves will without a doubt 
become a shining beacon not just for her 
peers, but for future generations of 
Umamusume too!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Therefore... You have my huuuuuge 
gratitude!! Splendidly done, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! And... EXPECTATION!! I eagerly 
await your unprecedented, legendary 
triumphs from here on out!!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"From me as well... truly, thank you for 
all your hard work as always. If there's 
anything I can help with, please feel free 
to ask me anytime."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems I've received some words of 
praise! I'm grateful, but... there was one 
thing that caught my attention.
choice_data_list: What was that silence all about?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Of course!! A surprise!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! I just felt like... that would 
build up more excitement!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry. I did try to stop them, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I do feel like retorting, but I'm 
honestly glad to be praised.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, I told <chrname> about this, and 
the two of us shared the joy together!
